name: Discover, navigation and featured Roblox experiences
description: Verify the app opens on a real Roblox-themed Discover screen and navigation works.
steps: Open LarpBlox
Confirm the five featured experience cards show Roblox thumbnails
Use the public username field to copy a profile
Navigate through Catalog, Avatar, Profile and Inventory
expected: Discover opens first, five featured experiences use public Roblox thumbnails, and navigation works.

name: Curated public Roblox catalog search and live asset details
covers: curated catalog search across 55 public Roblox items
public listing names and creator attribution
live asset-ID details through the backend
description: Search the curated public catalog shelf and verify the asset-ID detail route returns current public item information.
steps: Open Catalog
Search for Y2K, halo, spider and wings
Confirm results include public names, creator and price
Use asset ID lookup for a known public item
expected: Catalog search filters the curated public item shelf; asset-ID lookup returns live public item details and a Roblox thumbnail.

name: TikTok-linked UGC item try-on and demo purchase
covers: public Roblox item details through API route
description: Try featured UGC assets and use the local-only demo buy flow.
steps: Open Catalog
Open one TikTok source link and its Roblox listing link
Tap Try on for an item
Tap Buy · Demo and confirm
Open Inventory and Avatar
expected: The selected public asset appears in local inventory and can be equipped; demo purchase changes only local demo balance.

name: Backstage identity, profile import and visual badges
description: Verify profile copying and custom display settings in Backstage.
steps: Hold the top edge for about one second
Open Identity
Import a public Roblox username
Toggle the visual Verified and Premium badges
Reload the page
expected: Public profile fields import without passwords; visual badges and profile settings persist locally.

name: Avatar, inventory, friends, creations and backup
covers: public Roblox friends games avatar and collectibles API routes
read-only backend routes for public Roblox profile and inventory data
description: Verify all profile simulator sections and local data portability.
steps: Open Avatar and equip an item
Open Inventory and filter items
Manage friends, creations and badges in Backstage
Export profile JSON and import it again
Reset only after confirmation
expected: Items, friends, creations and badges update locally; backup restores state and reset is confirmed.
